messages:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT — reserved_capacity_pool=resv-west-2a-01 GPUs@100% | queue_len=1,320 | impacted_tenants=[AcmeCorp, BlueBank] | autoscaler=ERROR rate_limit 429
emma-sre: seeing it, joining. queue growth started ~09:12 UTC, we have steady arrival from BetaPipeline job set.
raj-oncall: oncall here. can you paste the pool id and a quick breakdown by tenant?
emma-sre: pool=resv-west-2a-01, by-tenant snapshot: AcmeCorp=420 jobs, BlueBank=310, default-shared=590. Reserved slots exhausted for AcmeCorp & BlueBank.
lucas-infra: autoscaler logs show repeated 429s from cloud API when requesting extra GPUs: 
```
2026-03-15T09:13:01Z ERROR autoscaler: AllocateNodes failed: rate_limit_exceeded (429) retrying
2026-03-15T09:14:12Z ERROR autoscaler: AllocateNodes failed: quota_exceeded (RequestLimit)
```
raj-oncall: ok. initial mitigation options: 1) enable burst-reservations for impacted tenants (if available), 2) evict low-priority batch jobs from reserved pool, 3) apply temporary per-tenant ingress throttling. thoughts?
sara-cs: AcmeCorp is in active production during their EOD run, customer-impact high if jobs delayed >5m. Pinged account manager @jen-am.
jen-am: on it, I'm drafting a note to Acme CS lead. please avoid evicting their in-flight jobs unless unavoidable. prefer throttling shared traffic first.
emma-sre: agreed. starting with shared/non-reserved eviction + throttle. running quick query to identify batch jobs older than 2h and non-reserved pods.
emma-sre: command: `rictl pool list --id resv-west-2a-01 --details` -> will filter by priority.
infra-bot: ACTION_STARTED autovacate-low-priority --pool resv-west-2a-01 --age 2h --exclude-tenants AcmeCorp,BlueBank --dry-run=false
prod-eng: FYI prod batch job set BetaPipeline has a config change in flight that increased concurrency unexpectedly. tagging for follow-up.
raj-oncall: starting ingress throttling for non-reserved routes to this pool. command: `rictl rate-limit set --pool resv-west-2a-01 --selector shared --rps 20`
emma-sre: applied throttle for shared: rps=20. monitoring queue.
lucas-infra: autoscaler still failing on allocate due to API 429s; my workaround: fall back to manual placement — we can allocate pre-warmed spare instances from warm-pool-west-2 if policy allows. executing manual placement request now.
emma-sre: manual placement command: `rictl placement allocate --from warm-pool-west-2 --to resv-west-2a-01 --count 4 --force`
infra-bot: placement_request: accepted (req-78cf). expected spin-up 6-8m.
raj-oncall: rolling eviction completed for 18 low-priority jobs, freed ~120 vGPU equivalents. queue dropped from 1,320 -> 950 in 3m.
sara-cs: AcmeCorp CS acknowledged we are investigating, they asked for ETA. I'll give ~10-15m while you try manual placement.
emma-sre: placement is booting, but one instance failed healthcheck — cloud-provider returned ENI attach timeout. I'm reissuing request for an extra node.
lucas-infra: event from cloud: "NodeCreationDelay: pending-attach=1"— if ENI keeps failing we'll request different AZ warm pool. doing that now.
prod-eng: noted that BetaPipeline config ramped concurrency to 8 -> 40 in last deploy at 08:59. reverting to previous rev is an option to reduce load immediately.
raj-oncall: can someone trigger a rollback on BetaPipeline? who owns that? @prod-eng?
prod-eng: I can roll back, but that will affect a few downstream jobs. propose roll back + throttle shared ingress. awaiting confirmation.
jen-am: rolling back a customer-facing job might be risky. prefer infra mitigations first. keep me posted.
emma-sre: placement succeeded, added 5 nodes, pool capacity +200 vGPU eq. queue now 480. Autoscaler still noisy, but manual placement kept us afloat.
raj-oncall: starting gradual resume of jobs for AcmeCorp with controlled concurrency: `rictl tenant set-concurrency --tenant AcmeCorp --pool resv-west-2a-01 --concurrency 6`
sara-cs: letting AcmeCorp know we restored capacity and we've set safe concurrency. sending update now.
jen-am: I told account lead that we have degraded performance for ~25min, manual mitigation in place, oncall will follow up with timeline.
emma-sre: follow-up actions: 1) autoscaler 429 root cause: cloud API rate limits + our burst pattern; need backoff/queueing fix. 2) create hard limit alerts for queue growth >800 for reserved pools. 3) coordination ticket to prod-eng about BetaPipeline config change.
lucas-infra: opened infra ticket INF-4823 to add exponential backoff and local-alloc fallback for autoscaler.
raj-oncall: opening incident handoff to postmortem: OWNER=emma-sre, SRE-support=lucas-infra, ENG-owner=prod-eng, CS=jen-am. setting follow-up meeting 09:50 UTC.
prod-eng: will revert the unintended concurrency change and add a guardrail in CI to prevent >12 concurrency unless flagged.
sara-cs: AcmeCorp confirmed degraded but accepts mitigation. BlueBank reports small delay, still monitoring.
emma-sre: closing alert stream. will post a short incident summary to #postmortems and add timeline + metrics.
incident-bot: RESOLVED — pool=resv-west-2a-01 back to healthy utilization 72% | queue_len=160 | duration=38m
jen-am: thanks all. please loop me into the postmortem so I can share a customer-facing summary. :pray:
raj-oncall: thanks team. handoff complete.
